name: web-abap2ui5
description: abap2UI5 running fully in the browser - downported, transpiled to JS and bundled for GitHub Pages.

scripts.check: npm run clone && npm test && npm run build:web
scripts.clone: rm -rf src && npm run clone:core && npm run clone:samples && node ci/check-abaplint-pin.mjs
scripts.clone:core: rm -rf abap2UI5 && git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/abap2UI5/abap2UI5 && cp -r abap2UI5/src src && rm -rf src/99 && mkdir -p src/99 && cp abap2UI5/src/99/package.devc.xml abap2UI5/src/99/z2ui5_if_exit.intf.abap abap2UI5/src/99/z2ui5_if_exit.intf.xml src/99/
scripts.clone:samples: rm -rf abap2UI5-samples && git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/abap2UI5/samples abap2UI5-samples && mkdir -p src/samples && cp -r abap2UI5-samples/src/. src/samples
scripts.build: npm run build:downport && npm run build:transpile && rm -rf src
scripts.build:downport: rm -rf downport && cp -r src downport && node ci/patch_diss_oref.mjs && node abap2UI5/node/setup/patch-abaplint-downport.mjs node_modules/@abaplint/cli/build/cli.js && abaplint --fix ./ci/abaplint-downport.jsonc && npm run build:syfixes
scripts.build:syfixes: find . -type f -name '*.abap' -exec sed -i -e 's/ RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found/ ASSERT 1 = 0/g' {} +
scripts.build:transpile: rm -rf output && cp srv/*.abap downport && abap_transpile ./ci/abap_transpile.json && node ci/patch_init_order.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit
